paper_title: Guided Search Strategies in Non-Serializable Environments with   Applications to Software Engineering Agents
caption: : Critic learns to distinguish successful and unsuccessful trajectories for GPT-4o.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the average critic score over relative time for different GPT-4o policies. The x-axis is labeled "Time (relative)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Average critic score" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with a tick label interval of 0.1. There are four lines in the plot: a solid green line representing the "GPT-4o policy, successful" trajectory, a solid red line for "GPT-4o policy, unsuccessful", a dashed green line for "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, successful", and a dashed red line for "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, unsuccessful". The solid green line starts at around 0.3 and increases to approximately 0.73, showing a steady rise. The solid red line begins at about 0.25 and remains relatively stable around 0.23. The dashed green line starts at 0.25 and rises to around 0.84, while the dashed red line begins at 0.25 and increases to about 0.41, both showing an overall upward trend.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the average critic score over relative time for different GPT-4o policies and their outcomes. The x-axis, labeled "Time (relative)", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Average critic score", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.2 to 0.85, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines: the green solid line represents the GPT-4o policy for successful outcomes, starting at approximately 0.3 and rising to around 0.73; the green dashed line represents the GPT-4o policy with 1-step lookahead for successful outcomes, beginning at about 0.26 and increasing to roughly 0.84; the red solid line represents the GPT-4o policy for unsuccessful outcomes, starting at around 0.26 and remaining relatively stable at approximately 0.23; and the red dashed line represents the GPT-4o policy with 1-step lookahead for unsuccessful outcomes, beginning at about 0.26 and rising to around 0.42. The successful outcome lines exhibit an overall upward trend, while the unsuccessful outcome lines remain relatively stable or show a slight increase.
